From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridgeboard triage + next steps for QBR package

Thanks team — quick recap from this morning's bridgeboard: Acme Health has three outstanding asks that need to be squared away before the QBR pack on 8/16. I pulled them into the attached triage matrix (bridgeboard-triage-matrix.xlsx). High level: 

1) Data residency confirmation for EU customers (Acme wants written confirmation of VPC options and KMS flow) — owner: Marissa
2) SLA/latency baseline for dedicated pools at 1000 TPS target (they want a 99th pct target for the demo) — owner: Karthik
3) SOC2 evidence for retention/audit logs (legal wants copies; tight timeline) — owner: Soojin (I will coordinate)

Action items (short):
- Marissa: update the VPC/KMS doc and share proposed language for the QBR one-pager by EOD 8/4.
- Karthik: provide a 1-page latency baseline (how we test 1000 TPS, expected p99) + recommended rollout plan by 8/7.
- Me (Soojin): compile SOC2 artifacts and push to the shared drive; ask Legal for expedited evidence by 8/6.

Sarah — tagging you to confirm whether Acme needs the VPC note in their contract addendum or just the one-pager at this stage.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bridgeboard-triage-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks, Soojin — I've started the VPC/KMS blurb and attached a draft QBR_one-pager_v2.pdf with suggested language for the "Data & Controls" box. Two quick notes: 

- Contract addendum: Acme said procurement prefers the language in the SOW addendum later, but they want the one-pager for the exec review next week. So we should treat the one-pager as the deliverable for the QBR and follow up on the addendum in parallel.
- KMS flow: I documented the high-level handoff and the proposed customer-managed key option; need confirmation from Legal on precise wording (cc'ing Vivek for visibility).

I'll iterate and push a new one-pager by 8/4 EOD. Also added an item in the matrix for dependent engineering work (small infra config to expose key rotation metadata).

Attachments: QBR_one-pager_v2.pdf (preview)

-Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Aug 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridgeboard triage + next steps for QBR package

Adding technical context — we've run a 1000 TPS load against a dedicated 8xA100 shard in our staging rig last quarter; p99 for short responses (~32 tokens) sits ~120ms in ideal conditions, but that assumes continuous batching and a warmed KV cache. For demo purposes we should: 

- Define the scenario (payload size / seq len) the Acme demo will use.
- Commit to a warm cache baseline (we can script a warm-up).
- Offer an alternate fallback (smaller model quantized) if they want a strict sub-200ms p99 for a broader set of inputs.

I'll put the numbers and a test plan into a 1-page PDF and a short runbook (expected by 8/7). If Legal needs wording about latency in the SOW, let's get the phrasing early.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: serving-1000tps-runbook.pdf (draft)

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Park <matt@brightcloud.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridgeboard triage + next steps for QBR package

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from Acme side: 

- For the QBR we only need the one-pager and the latency baseline slides. Procurement will escalate the addendum once execs sign off. 
- Demo scenario: 90% of our requests are < 64 tokens, but clinical notes can be ~180 tokens. For the exec demo please prioritize the <64 token path; we'll surface the long-tail behavior in the technical appendix. 
- SOC2 artifacts: legal's request list is attached here — I've redacted some items but the list should map closely to your SOC2-evidence-request.pdf.

Apologies — sending the procurement note as a separate attachment now. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful (I can do Thu morning PST).

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Health

Attachment: acme-procurement-clarifications.pdf (procurement note)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 9 Aug 2028 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Bridgeboard triage + next steps for QBR package — exec-ready summary

Folks — final exec-ready rollup for the QBR packet (see attached QBR_one-pager_v2.pdf updated):

Summary of open asks (for exec slide):
- Data residency / KMS — one-pager language complete; procurement addendum tracked separately. Owner: Marissa (deliverable: updated one-pager)
- Latency baseline for 1000 TPS demo — Karthik to deliver p99 numbers + test plan; recommend warm-cache demo + small-model fallback.
- SOC2 evidence — compiling artifacts; I've requested expedited sign-off from Legal. Owner: Soojin

Risks / asks for exec review:
- Timeline risk: SOC2 artifact collection is the gating item; if Legal requires full packaged evidence we may need a 1-week extension for the customer-facing packet.
- Engineering work (key rotation metadata exposure) is low scope but needs scheduling in infra sprint this week to avoid a follow-up ask post-QBR.

Next steps:
- Marissa: final one-pager by COB 8/9.
- Karthik: runbook + numbers by COB 8/7 (aim to close this morning/Wednesday).
- Me: push SOC2 artifacts to the shared drive and update HubSpot with deliverable links by 8/10.

If no objections I'll share this summary with Acme and drop the QBR one-pager into the shared drive.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn.

-Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_one-pager_v2.pdf (final), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (stub)
